sn22.69:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Sādhu me bhante Bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu || pe || vihareyyan ti || || Yaṃ kho bhikkhu anattaniyaṃ tatra te chando pahātabbo ti || || Aññātam Bhagavā aññātaṃ Sugatāti || ||
sn22.69:2.1: Yathā katham pana tvam bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena attham ājānāsīti || || Rūpaṃ kho bhante anattaniyaṃ || tatra me chando pahātabbo || || Vedanā || || Saññā || || Saṅkhārā || || Viññāṇam anattaniyaṃ || tatra me chando pahātabbo || || Imassa khvāham bhante Bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attham ājānāmīti || ||
sn22.69:3.1: Sādhu sādhu bhikkhu || sādhu kho tvaṃ bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena attham ājānāsi || || Rūpaṃ kho bhikkhu anattaniyaṃ || tatra te chando pahātabbo || || Vedanā || || Saññā || || Saṅkhārā || || Viññāṇam anattaniyam || tatra te chando pahātabbo || || Imassa kho bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabbo ti || || Atha || pa || Aññataro ca pana so bhikkhu arahataṃ ahosīti || || Sāvatthi ||
